lines.say: Four thousand years. One family tree.
According to the Torah, it starts with one man in Ur: Abraham.
His two sons: Ishmael and Isaac. Remember Ishmael.
Isaac's grandson Jacob is renamed Israel. His family ends up slaves in Egypt.
At Mount Sinai, they receive the Torah. One God.
Around one thousand B.C., King David makes Jerusalem the capital. Solomon builds the Temple.
Five eighty-six B.C., Babylon destroys it. Exile.
Persia's King Cyrus lets them return. They build the Second Temple.
Around A.D. thirty, Rome crucifies a Jewish teacher from Galilee: Jesus.
His followers believe he is the Messiah. Split number one: Christianity.
One faith still waits for the Messiah. One says he came.
And Ishmael's line? It wakes up in A.D. six-ten. Part two, on my profile.
Which part was new to you?
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
Every branch goes back to one root.

caption_en:
The last branch on this tree has not woken up yet. 🌳

According to the Torah, it starts c. 2000 BC with one man in Ur: Abraham, and his two sons, Ishmael and Isaac.
Isaac's grandson Jacob is renamed Israel. His family ends up enslaved in Egypt. At Mount Sinai they receive the Torah: one God (Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy 6:4; tradition, dates debated).
c. 1000 BC: King David makes Jerusalem the capital (the Tel Dan Stele, 9th century BC, names the "House of David"). Solomon builds the First Temple.
586 BC: Babylon destroys it. Exile.
539 BC: Persia's King Cyrus lets them return (Cyrus Cylinder, British Museum). 516 BC: the Second Temple (Ezra 6:15). From Judah come the words Jew and Judaism.
c. AD 30: Rome crucifies a Jewish teacher from Galilee, Jesus (Tacitus, Annals 15.44, c. AD 116). His followers believe he is the Messiah: Christianity. Judaism still waits for the Messiah.

And Ishmael's line? It wakes up in AD 610. Part 2 is on my profile.

Two faiths, one root. Each tells the story its own way.
Which part was new to you? Tell me in the comments.

Quotes: Genesis 12:2 and Deuteronomy 6:4 (NIV); Tacitus, Annals 15.44 (Church and Brodribb translation).

caption_he:
ארבעת אלפים שנה. עץ משפחה אחד.
לפי התורה, הכול מתחיל באור כשדים עם אדם אחד: אברהם, ושני בניו, ישמעאל ויצחק. יעקב נקרא ישראל, משפחתו משועבדת במצרים, ובהר סיני מקבלים את התורה: אל אחד.
דוד המלך הופך את ירושלים לבירה, שלמה בונה את בית המקדש הראשון. 586 לפני הספירה: בבל מחריבה אותו. כורש מחזיר את הגולים, ובית המקדש השני נבנה.
בסביבות שנת 30 לספירה רומא צולבת מורה יהודי מהגליל, ישו. תלמידיו מאמינים שהוא המשיח: הנצרות.
ומה עם הענף של ישמעאל? הוא מתעורר בשנת 610. חלק 2 בפרופיל שלי.
איזה חלק היה חדש לכם?
